appraisal_events.evidence: « Il me faut un « bon pour un baiser ». — Faut-il que je le signe ? » ... « Vous m'amusez avec vos bons, je vous en referai de temps en temps. »
appraisal_events.explanation: Albertine plays along with the narrator's coy request for a deferred kiss and promises to grant more of these 'vouchers' in the future, producing a warm, mutually complicit exchange even though no kiss is actually taken in this passage.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator secures Albertine's playful, open-ended promise of future kisses, gaining reassured emotional access to her even as the kiss itself is postponed.
Albertine sets and controls the playful terms of the exchange, treating the narrator's request as an amusing game she indulges on her own terms.
